fields.description: Root territory that defines Moldova fiscal scope
fields.label: Fiscal Territory

fields.description: If enabled, Fetch and daily sync also include Sales eFactura with SFS status Archived (6).
fields.label: Include Archived Invoices

fields.description: If enabled, submit of a Sales eFactura is blocked when cumulative stock qty of any item across submitted documents exceeds the linked Sales Invoice. If disabled, the user must confirm the overage in the document form before submit.
fields.label: Block Submit When Qty Exceeds Sales Invoice

fields.description: If enabled, Sales eFactura in status Rejected by Customer or Canceled by Supplier do not occupy Sales Invoice quantity. You can reissue without cancelling the failed document in ERPNext. If disabled, those documents keep the qty until they are cancelled.
fields.label: Exclude Rejected / Canceled from Qty Quota

fields.description: If enabled, saving a Draft Sales eFactura asks for confirmation when this document plus other Draft and submitted documents exceed the Sales Invoice qty. Submit still checks only submitted documents.
fields.label: Confirm Draft Save When Qty Exceeds Sales Invoice

fields.description: Allowed Item Tax Templates when loading a Sales eFactura from SFS. A line with a VAT % gets the first template from this list with the same rate.
fields.label: Item Tax Templates

fields.description: Per company: Tax Category, Sales Taxes template, and VAT account for Sales Order / Sales Invoice created from a Sales eFactura.
fields.label: Sales Tax Settings

fields.description: Select field from Company used to store IDNO
fields.label: Company IDNO field

fields.description: Select field from Customer used to store IDNO
fields.label: Customer IDNO field

fields.description: Select field from Supplier used to store IDNO
fields.label: Supplier IDNO field

fields.description: One row per legal entity. Username and password are required on each row; there is no site-wide API user. Fetch and daily sync poll each account into that Company.
fields.label: Company API Accounts

fields.description: If enabled, Fetch and daily sync also include Purchase eFactura with SFS status Archived (6).
fields.label: Include Archived Invoices

fields.description: If enabled, Fetch and daily sync do not insert new Sales or Purchase eFactura that are already cancelled by the supplier in SFS. Existing documents still receive the cancelled status.
fields.label: Do Not Create Cancelled eFactura

fields.description: If enabled, Purchase Invoice posting date and time and Purchase Order transaction date are copied from the e-Factura issue date.
fields.label: Copy Issue Date to Purchase Invoice / Order

fields.description: Per company: Tax Category, Purchase Taxes template, and VAT account for Purchase Order / Purchase Invoice created from a Purchase eFactura.
fields.label: Purchase Tax Settings

fields.description: Maps e-Factura UOM text from SFS XML to an ERPNext UOM. Used when Fetch / sync creates Sales eFactura and Purchase eFactura.
fields.label: UOM Mapping

fields.description: If enabled, an unmapped e-Factura UOM is added here when a Sales or Purchase eFactura is loaded from SFS or when items are mapped.
fields.label: Auto-add UOM Map
